messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-01-31] standup/atlas/2025-01-31: Ledger must stay on Postgres 14 until the partitioning work finishes.
- [2025-09-24] standup/atlas/2025-09-24: Ledger deploy window (unchanged): on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.
- [2025-07-17] standup/atlas/2025-07-17: The ledger remains a Atlas service.
- [2025-08-25] standup/atlas/2025-08-25: New deploy window for Ledger: on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC. Forget the previous weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC slot.
- [2025-01-08] standup/atlas/2025-01-08: For the record, the ledger service is owned by the Atlas team.
- [2025-06-24] standup/dune/2025-06-24: Reporting still relies on Ledger; keep that in mind for the maintenance.
- [2026-03-11] standup/cinder/2026-03-11: No deploys to Ledger from 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 because of the fiscal year close.
- [2025-09-23] standup/dune/2025-09-23: Reporting switches from Ledger to the bus as its source. Why: the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. Reporting no longer depends on Ledger.
- [2025-01-14] standup/atlas/2025-01-14: Reminder that Ledger only ships on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC.
- [2025-11-04] standup/atlas/2025-11-04: Reminder that the billing API depends on the ledger.
- [2025-03-04] standup/atlas/2025-03-04: If the auth gateway is down, the ledger service is down: it relies on it for service tokens.
- [2025-10-13] handover/2025-10-13-ledger: From today the pager for the ledger rings Cinder, not team Atlas. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-01-09] standup/atlas/2025-01-09-2: Dependency map update: billing-api needs Ledger (invoice postings).
- [2026-04-16] standup/atlas/2026-04-16: The Atlas team saw that the ledger service's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-02-21] standup/boreal/2025-02-21-2: Boreal noticed that the ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners.
- [2026-05-28] standup/ember/2026-05-28: Ember noticed that the ledger service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners.
- [2025-01-21] standup/dune/2025-01-21: Dependency map update: reporting needs the ledger service (the nightly balance export).
- [2025-03-28] standup/atlas/2025-03-28: Priya still has the Atlas pager.
- [2026-05-27] standup/atlas/2026-05-27: Decided in today's standup: the event-bus will retain messages for seven days, since replaying a full week has covered every incident recovery so far. The Atlas team noticed that search-indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. The catalog still relies on the resizer; keep that in mind for the maintenance.
- [2025-05-30] incident-review/INC-2025-011: Review of INC-2025-011 (Ledger, 2025-05-24). The root cause was an index missing after the schema migration. We decided that ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan, because a missing index after a migration caused INC-2025-011.
- [2025-09-30] standup/atlas/2025-09-30: Decision: billing-api will gate the new invoice flow behind feature-flags, because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch. The billing API now depends on the feature flag service. The Atlas team planning meeting is every Tuesday.
- [2025-12-18] standup/boreal/2025-12-18: Rotation day for Boreal: Marcus hands the pager to Lena. Boreal adopted a weekly dependency update day.
- [2025-01-08] standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2: The billing API lives with the Atlas team. For the record, feature-flags is owned by Atlas.
- [2025-04-29] standup/ember/2025-04-29: The scheduler still relies on the feature flag service; keep that in mind for the maintenance.
- [2026-03-03] standup/cinder/2026-03-03: The auth gateway deploy window (unchanged): on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.
- [2026-06-04] standup/atlas/2026-06-04: Priya Raman has the Atlas pager this cycle, taking over from Marcus.
- [2026-01-22] standup/atlas/2026-01-22: The product catalog deploy window (unchanged): on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays.
- [2025-04-22] standup/cinder/2025-04-22: The search indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11; the pin lifts when the full reindex completes.
- [2025-06-06] standup/ember/2025-06-06: Decided in today's standup: the scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node, since the fixed node turned every restart into a missed run.
- [2026-01-30] standup/cinder/2026-01-30: We agreed today that auth-gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour. The reason is that the security audit flagged long-lived tokens.
- [2025-11-11] standup/atlas/2025-11-11: Deploy freeze for the billing API: 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02 (the peak season).
- [2026-02-03] standup/atlas/2026-02-03: The Atlas team now does a no-deploy Friday.

Question: Which version is the ledger pinned to, and until when?

message.content: Postgres 14, until the partitioning work finishes.
message.reasoning:
The user asks: Which version is the ledger pinned to, and until when?

Looking through memory:
- [2025-01-31] Ledger must stay on Postgres 14 until the partitioning work finishes.

That's a pin on Postgres 14 until the partitioning work finishes. There's no other version pin for ledger. Search indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11 but that's not the ledger.

So the answer: Postgres 14, until the partitioning work finishes.
